verses.translation: When the sky has split [open]
And has listened [i.e., responded][1888] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.footnotes: [1888]- It will have heard Allāh's command and will have inclined immediately to compliance and willing obedience.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the earth has been extended[1889]
verses.footnotes: [1889]- i.e., stretched flat and spread out.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive
segments.gloss: to spread, to extend, to prolong

verses.translation: And has cast out that within it[1890] and relinquished [it]
verses.footnotes: [1890]- Of the dead and all else buried therein.

segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

verses.translation: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] –

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
verses.translation: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion[1891] and will meet it.[1892]
verses.footnotes:
[1891]- i.e., striving throughout your life until you meet your Lord, hastening toward death.
[1892]- i.e., you will find all that you intended and accomplished awaiting you in the Hereafter. Another meaning is "And will meet Him [i.e., your Lord]" and be recompensed in full by Him.

verses.translation: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: He will be judged with an easy account

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And return to his people in happiness.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
verses.translation: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: He will cry out for destruction

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to call, to invite, to pray

verses.translation: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].

segments.gloss: to think, to assume, to guess

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
verses.translation: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.
So I swear by the twilight glow
And [by] the night and what it envelops
And [by] the moon when it becomes full
[That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.[1893]
verses.footnotes: [1893]- i.e., various stages, both in this life and in the Hereafter.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ
verses.translation: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: But those who have disbelieved deny,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
verses.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
